verdict.summary_en: Korean-language delivery note DN-260827-918 dated 2026.08.27 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg against PO 4500318705. One line: CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 12 000 PCS, 6 boxes, total 120 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. Remarks field is empty. Signed by hand in the receiver field 'Schulz P.' and bears a red Hwaseong Memory company seal. No corrections, strike-throughs or receiving date stamp.
observations: Red round company seal 'HWASEONG MEMORY CO LTD' with a star overlaps the 단위 (unit) column header and the edge of the PCS and box cells; the values PCS and 6 remain readable.
Receiver signature 'Schulz P.' is handwritten in blue ink on the 인수자 line; no receiving date is written next to it.
The stamp has no date; there is no goods-receipt date on the document.
Barcode at top right; not decoded.
